service.description: The registration events of the caller's organizations (an organization's, or a campaign's when marketingCampaignId names one of them, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise), by text (name or place), the first occurrence's date range and the offers' state (ErpDraft, ErpPublished or none), soonest first, a page at a time: each with its organization, when in its zone, where, campaigns, offers, the confirmed, held and waitlisted places against the seats, and its state. Any Marketing reader (PERMISSION_DENIED for a caller who reads nothing of Marketing); canCreate for an events manager.

One registration event for RegistrationSetup and its tabs: the event (when, where, online or not, repeating, campaigns, places against seats), each offer with its window, seats and places taken, hold, waitlist, terms, site, store, ticket types (each priced by its source, never an amount of its own), questions, notices, readiness checks and public address once published, the occurrences still to come with no offer, and what the caller may do (canManage: MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE; canEditEvent: the calendar's own rule). Any Marketing reader of the event's organization; another organization's event is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

Offers registration for a calendar event (a WetEvent) by an internal organization of the caller's scope, once: an events manager (MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE) who may edit the event (its organizer or an editor of its calendar, EVENT_EDIT_REQUIRED otherwise); the same organization again changes nothing, another is ORGANIZATION_FIXED. With marketingCampaignId, the event's link to an open campaign of that organization (CampaignAssociation CakEvent, made once) through mantle.marketing.CampaignServices.store#CampaignAssociation, a change of the campaign: the caller also holds MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT (CAMPAIGN_EDIT_REQUIRED otherwise). Called after mantle.work.EventServices.create#Event by NewEvent.

A registration offer for one occurrence of a registration event (new: workEffortId and, for a series, occurrenceStart, the start its rule gives the occurrence; OCCURRENCE_REQUIRED, OCCURRENCE_UNAVAILABLE, OCCURRENCE_PAST, OFFER_EXISTS) or a change of one at the revision read (registrationPolicyId, expectedRevision): its public title and description, the zone its times are shown in, the site (an enabled Marketing mount of the organization), an optional store of the organization (a store order; storeless by default), the window (WINDOW_INVALID), the seats (never fewer than the places held or confirmed now: CAPACITY_BELOW_TAKEN), the hold in minutes, the waitlist, the terms and cancellation terms (a change after publication raises termsRevision) and the notices' sending profile. A closed offer is not changed (POLICY_CLOSED). MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

A ticket type of an offer (new: registrationPolicyId) or a change at the revision read (ticketTypeId, expectedRevision), or its end (action end): its name, price source (EtpFree, or EtpProduct with a ticket product the organization sells, not kept in inventory, linked to the event by WorkEffortProduct; no amount is kept), its places within the offer's seats (never fewer than its places held or confirmed: CAPACITY_BELOW_TAKEN), its sales dates and the places one order may take (1 to 50). A ticket type with places taken keeps its product. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

An offer's registration questions at its revision read: a published registration form (purpose DbfpRegistration) of the organization (FORM_INVALID, FORM_NOT_PUBLISHED), kept as the offer's publication of purpose registration (Commons' FormPublication: anonymous, on the offer's site, open while the offer is; a new form closes the earlier one, an empty formId ends them), whom they are for (ErqAttendee, ErqBuyer) and the consent text a registrant accepts with them (a change after publication raises termsRevision). MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

A notice of an offer (new: registrationPolicyId) or a change at the revision read (scheduleId, expectedRevision), or its end (action end): its trigger (confirmed, before the start, after the end, changed, cancelled) and offset in minutes, an email template of the organization in use, whom it goes to and its kind (transactional under the registration's authority, or promotional, which needs the recipient's promotional consent; a promotional template is never a transactional notice). Sent by P17's job, once per registration, through the delivery ledger. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

Publishes a draft offer at its revision read when it is ready (NOT_READY naming each missing check): an occurrence still to come of an event not cancelled, seats, a ticket type, each paid ticket priced in the organization's currency, a window that closes after it opens and by the occurrence's end, a published site whose Marketing mount serves the organization, a ready transactional sending profile for the notices, a payment gateway of the organization (or of the offer's store) when a ticket has a price, and the questions' form published when it has questions. Its question publication opens with it. Answers the PASS Event page's address. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

Closes an offer at its revision read (with a reason): its page is no longer available and its question publication closes; the places taken stay. Once only. MARKETING_EVENT_MANAGE in the event's organization.

An online event's call (design §9 EventDetail "Add video call", L7): a call link of the framework (lobby, video, lasting past its offers' last occurrence) as the event's join address (WorkEffort.infoUrl), once (CALL_EXISTS). An events manager of the event's organization who may edit the event. Registrants receive the link with their confirmation (P17); the public page says the event is online and never shows it.
